patterns: What kind of college is this
responses: Our college is a leading institution offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in engineering, sciences and management, with a strong focus on research and industry collaboration.
We offer undergraduate programs (B.Tech, B.Sc, BBA, BCA) and postgraduate programs (M.Tech, M.Sc, MBA, MCA) across Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical, Civil and Management streams.
Admissions are based on entrance exam scores and merit. You can apply online through our official admissions portal during the application window, usually from May to July each year.

patterns: Where can I find my timetable
responses: You can view your timetable on the student portal under the 'Academics' section. Timetables are updated every semester.

patterns: How can I check my attendance
responses: Your attendance is available on the student portal under the 'Attendance' tab. Students are required to maintain at least 75% attendance to be eligible for end-semester exams.
Mid-semester exams are held in the middle of each semester and end-semester exams at the end. The detailed exam schedule is published on the exam portal a few weeks in advance.
The fee structure varies by program. Detailed fees and payment options are on the college website under 'Fee Structure'. Scholarships are available for merit and need-based candidates.

patterns: How many books can I issue
responses: The central library is open from 8 AM to 10 PM on weekdays and 9 AM to 6 PM on weekends. Students can borrow up to 5 books at a time and also access the digital e-library remotely.
Separate hostels are available for boys and girls with Wi-Fi, mess, laundry and 24x7 security. You can apply for hostel accommodation through the student portal after admission.
Our placement cell has strong industry connections. Over 200 companies visit each year including top MNCs. The average package is around 8 LPA and the highest package last year was 42 LPA.
You can contact the college at info@college.edu or call the admissions office at +91-11-1234-5678. The office is open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
The college is located on Main Campus Road, Sector 21, New Delhi. It is well connected by metro and city buses, and you can find directions on the college website map.

patterns: Is the office open on Sunday
responses: The college office is open Monday to Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM. It remains closed on Sundays and public holidays.
For technical issues please email support@college.edu with your student ID and a screenshot. The IT helpdesk usually responds within one working day.
